title: Guarantees on Dynamical System Distinguishability for LLM Token Generation
abstract: arXiv:2607.28667v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent work has shown that classifying large language models (LLMs)' responses can be distinguished by modeling token embeddings as trajectories of a black-box dynamical system (DS) and comparing prediction residuals of two DSs.
